questions.stem: A patient at the orthopedics OPD complains of troubled sleep at night due to numbness and tingling sensation involving his lateral 3 digits. His symptoms are relieved as he lays his arms hanging from the bed. Which amongst the following options correctly describes his condition along with the test used to assess it?
